Sahla

Sahla builds fully branded iOS and Android apps for mosques - a mosque's own app in the App Store, with their name, colors, and community.

Sahla gives mosque communities prayer times, donations, programs, events, and sponsor revenue tools in a white-labeled app, with a CRM for the mosque team behind it.

Contact: info@sahla.co
